title: Operator inbox: skip prompts from headless and benchmark runs
body: Found 2026-11-07 by the lead: headless runs started from a worktree or temp copy of this repository (claude -p for a permission check, an ad-hoc hook benchmark with session "bench" that wrote 60 "hello bench" entries) record their prompts in the lead operator inbox (.krn/operator/inbox.jsonl in the main checkout), because capture resolves the inbox to the main checkout and cannot tell an operator prompt from an automated one. Make capture skip non-interactive sessions (find the field in the real UserPromptSubmit payload of a claude -p run — capture it verbatim — or an env marker the runner sets), test with that captured payload, and dispose the existing noise.
